newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany's ZVEI, VDMA trade groups consider merger.
newsitem.headline: Germany's ZVEI, VDMA trade groups consider merger.

text.p: Two German industry associations said on Monday that they were contemplating merging together as part of cost-cutting measures.

The two associations, the VDMA association of machinery and plant construction and the ZVEI association of the electronic industry, said the boards of both associations would review recommendations for the merger.
The associations said the decision to consider merging was based on convergence of the two industries in terms of automation of production.
